caution: do not strike the steering shaft with a hammer

do: Look at the cancel cam
how: If its tabs are broken the turn signal will not cancel; the cam is sold alone (BA29-66-126), the combination switch need not come out

do: Prise the old cam off
how: Turn signal at OFF; pry the cam carefully off the combination switch with a screwdriver

do: Fit the new cam
how: Press it onto the switch; no extra grease is needed

do: Refit the wheel on its marks
how: Align the cam's tabs with the holes in the wheel; nut to 40-50 N m (29-36 ft-lb)
expect: the signal cancels as the wheel returns
caution: a cam whose tabs miss the holes breaks when the wheel is tightened

do: Take out the battery and the radiator shroud top cover
how: Battery cables and battery out; the shroud cover's 6 bolts

do: Fit the compressor mount to the engine
how: Mount MZ-97-A-1 with the two 3/8 in spacers at the front holes; front bolts 10 x 1.25 x 30 mm with 10 mm lockwashers, top rear 10 x 1.25 x 20 mm with a 3/8 in lockwasher, the 12 mm hex nut on the stud; tighten all evenly (SP-728..730)

do: Hang the compressor and its belt
how: 3/8 x 5 in NC pivot bolt from the front at the bottom (SP-731); hose fittings pointing up; belt over the crank pulley and clutch; two 3/8 x 1-1/2 in NC adjusting bolts in the top slots (SP-732); spark plug wire holder on the rear adjusting arm bolt (SP-733); tension the belt (SP-1784) and tighten
caution: the water pump pulley position must suit the A/C belt; plug wires clipped into the holder

do: Fit the condenser
how: Brackets to the condenser with eight #10 x 3/4 in screws (SP-1025); condenser in front of the radiator, studs through the cowling holes on the passenger side with flat washers and 1/4 in kepnuts, the driver's side with two 1/4 in bolts; the condenser-to-drier hose at about 45 degrees up and forward

do: Fit the receiver-drier
how: Two bands and #10-32 x 1/2 in screws with kepnuts (SP-1031); bracket to the radiator cowling with two 1/4 in kepnuts (SP-1032); liquid line from the condenser to the drier inlet, oiled, tightened

do: Run the discharge hose
how: Foam protector on; through the hole in the radiator cowling (driver's side, nearest the radiator); to the condenser's top fitting, oiled; clamp to the stand-off bracket; under the car harness by the battery box; a second protector where it passes the body; to the compressor

do: Take out the glove box and the blower motor
how: Glove box and door (screws under the door, the support arm, each corner, the latch striker); blower motor's three 6 mm nuts, leaving its coupler and cable; the duct between heater and blower is discarded
caution: mind the fresh-recirculate cable above the glove box

do: Plug the A/C short connector into the blower
how: The white 2-wire plastic short connector onto the male terminals at the back of the blower by the resistor connector; refit the blower
caution: do not leave this out

do: Fit the micro switch
how: On the right of the heater behind the defroster hose with two #10 x 1/2 in screws; yellow wire to its bottom spade, green to its end spade; adjust it with PR-193

do: Fit the evaporator
how: Knock out the firewall insulation for the hoses, mounts, harness and drain; seal plates loosely on the heater outlet and inlet; blue and yellow wires through the firewall to the yellow tape (about 2 ft); lines through the firewall holes, top bracket over the dash-panel stud with a 6 mm nut, lower brackets to the firewall; slide the seals against their stops and tighten

do: Wire the A/C
how: Green wire (female bullet) to the blower's blue/green; blue to the blower's blue/green male; the relay at the original relay's place (turn the existing one round to tuck it under); yellow and blue from the relay along the firewall, tied to the hood release cable and the brake vacuum line; white coupler to the car's coupler (black/white and blue/red); clutch lead looped through the compressor's hole, black to the clutch wire

do: Run the liquid hose
how: Drier to evaporator through the grommeted hole at the upper right of the radiator cowling; clamp to the front body panel lip; a 1/4 in hole to clamp it near the overflow tank; clamp to the shock tower's forward stud; to the evaporator at the firewall
caution: the line clears the headlight door mechanism by at least 2 in (SP-1035)

do: Run the suction hose
how: The 110 degree end to the evaporator (SP-1037), along the firewall with a #10 clamp, foam protector by the hood latch, the stand-off bracket at the latch; the 45 degree end under the hot start cable to the compressor

do: Close up
how: Grommets round the lines at the firewall; shroud cover back with the coolant level sensor clips on its two left bolts; battery in; cut the carpet at the drain; drain hose through the firewall grommet with the 90 degree elbow to the evaporator's drain port

do: Check the seals and the fresh-recirculate door
how: Blower on: feel for leaks round the evaporator inlet and outlet and adjust the seal plates; mode lever to fresh - the door seals against the blower inlet grille - and to recirculate - it moves away

do: Refit the glove box
how: Original screws; then evacuate and charge the system (not in this sheet)

do: Move the heater lever between max and bi-level
expect: the micro switch is not actuated

do: Move it from bi-level to heat
expect: the switch clicks (actuated)

do: Adjust if it does not
how: Slide the switch bracket in its slotted hole

do: Tighten the bracket
how: The bracket's screws to the heater once it works
caution: a misadjusted switch runs the compressor in heat and defrost and spoils defrosting

do: Make the car safe and disconnect the battery
how: Parking brake on, wheels blocked; battery negative off

do: Free the top of the gearbox
how: Unplug the inhibitor switch coupler; remove the converter housing upper cover; pull the vacuum diaphragm's sensing tube; disconnect the air pipe; remove the thermal reactor cover; remove the upper transmission-to-engine bolts

do: Raise the car and take out the propeller shaft
how: On stands; propeller shaft out (Section 8); the turning holder 49 0259 440 into the extension housing
caution: without the holder the fluid runs out of the extension

do: Clear the exhaust air ducts
how: Air pipe (thermal reactor to air duct) off; the air duct's nuts at the thermal reactor, its hanger and its joint at the silencer

do: Take out the starter and the lower cover
how: Starter wires off, bracket and starter out; converter housing lower cover off

do: Unbolt the converter from the drive plate
how: Mark the drive plate and converter for realignment; turn the engine to reach each bolt and remove them with the wrench 49 0877 435

do: Support the gearbox and engine
how: A jack under the transmission and one under the engine; remove the remaining transmission-to-engine bolts

do: Disconnect the last connections
how: Speedometer cable; the select rod at the select lever; the transmission support's nuts to the body; lower the gearbox enough to reach and disconnect the fluid pipes

do: Slide the gearbox out
how: Rearward until the input shaft clears the eccentric shaft's end, then lower the transmission and converter together
expect: the converter stays on the gearbox
caution: keep the converter from falling off the front

do: Refit in the reverse order of PR-194
Bolt the converter to the drive plate on its marks
how: Align the painted marks; bolts 35-50 N m (3.5-5.0 m-kg, 25-36 ft-lb) (S-038 T:7 rows)

do: Fill and test
how: Fill with ATF to the level (PR-196; capacity and type SP-1753); then the stall test (PR-199), a road test (PR-200) and the line pressure check (PR-197)

do: Park level with the brake on
how: Level ground, parking brake firmly on

do: Warm the engine
how: To working temperature, with a steady idle

do: Run the selector through every position
how: Through all drive positions, then leave it in P
expect: the engine stays running for the check

do: Wipe and reinsert the dipstick
how: Wipe the cap clean, pull the dipstick, wipe it and push it fully home

do: Read the level
expect: between the L and F marks; top up with ATF Type F (SP-093)

do: Warm the fluid and check the basics
how: Fluid at working temperature; fluid level (PR-196) and idle speed within specification

do: Fit the gauge
how: Pressure gauge 49 0378 400A on the pressure outlet at the right rear of the case, placed so it is read from the driver's seat

do: Block the car
how: Chocks front and rear, parking brake on
caution: press the brake pedal firmly with the left foot before touching the accelerator

do: Read the idle pressure in D
expect: 300-400 kPa (S-038 T:5 line pressure row)

do: Read the stall pressure in D
how: Press the accelerator slowly to wide open, watching the pressure rise smoothly, and read it at stall
caution: no more than 5 s from pressing to releasing

do: Cool the converter
how: Selector to N, idle for more than a minute

do: Repeat for R, 2 and 1
Fit the gauge
how: Fluid level checked; gauge 49 0378 400A on the pressure outlet

do: Read it at the set road speeds
how: Drive at 20, 35 and 55 mph and read the pressure
expect: 80-130, 160-230, 340-450 kPa (S-038 T:5 governor rows); out of range: take out and check the governor valve

do: Warm the fluid and check its level
Fit a tachometer and block the car
how: Chocks front and rear, parking brake on
caution: left foot hard on the brake before the accelerator

do: Read the stall speed in D
how: Selector in D, accelerator to the floor, read the engine speed
expect: 2350-2600 rpm after break-in (S-038 T:4)
caution: no more than 5 s

do: Cool the converter
how: N, idle more than a minute

do: Repeat in 2, 1 and R
expect: the same stall speed in each

do: Drive in D
expect: D1 to D2 to D3 changes

do: Check reverse
how: In R the engine speed does not run away

do: Check kick-down
how: Floor the accelerator in D3 at a speed below the kick-down limit
expect: it changes down

do: Shift from D to 1 on the move
expect: D3 to 2 (12) to 11, with engine braking in 12 and 11

do: Check 1 and 2 held
how: In 1 the speed does not rise past first; in 2 it stays in second

do: Check P holds the car
how: Park on a slope in P
expect: the car does not move

do: Check the shift speeds
Selector to N, car on stands
Disconnect the T-joint
how: From the lower end of the selector lever operating arm

do: Put the gearbox lever in N
how: The transmission's range lever to N, the third detent from the rear

do: Set the T-joint
how: Loosen its nuts and adjust it until it enters the operating arm's hole freely; tighten the nuts

do: Reconnect and check
how: Connect and secure the T-joint; lower the car; try every selector position
expect: each position engages

do: Lever in N or D, loosen the knob
how: Loosen the knob's lock nut and screw the knob lightly fully in

do: Back it out one turn
how: So the push button faces the driver

do: Check P with the button
how: Push the button: the lever goes into P; if not, screw the knob in one turn

do: Check the lock without the button
how: Without the button the lever does not go N to R or D to 2; if it does, screw the knob out

do: Tighten and check the start lock
how: Lock nut 15-20 N m (1.5-2.0 m-kg); the starter turns only in N and P

do: Free the switch
how: Unplug its connectors; loosen the lock nut and screw the switch out a few turns

do: Floor the accelerator
Screw the switch in to the click
how: Gradually, until it clicks, then half a turn more

do: Lock it and reconnect
how: Tighten the lock nut; connectors back on

do: Selector to N, car on stands
Loosen the switch
how: Loosen its attaching bolts; remove the screw in the switch body

do: Align it with a pin
how: Move the switch until the screw hole lines up with the small hole inside; check with a 2.0 mm pin through both

do: Fix it
how: Snug the bolts, pull the pin, refit the screw, tighten the bolts (5-7 N m, S-038 T:7)
expect: the starter turns only in N and P

do: Drain and mount the gearbox
how: Drain the ATF; on the stand 49 0378 320A; converter and converter housing off; input shaft out of the pump; extension housing and oil pan off

do: Take off the outside parts
how: Downshift solenoid, vacuum diaphragm and rod, control valve body, inhibitor switch; parking lever snap ring and lever, parking rod; manual plate nut, then the manual shaft and plate

do: Take out the pump and the front train
how: Servo cover off; loosen the piston stem lock nut and snug the stem to hold the front clutch drum; pump out with the puller 49 0378 390; band retaining bolt out, stem loosened, band strut out; band, front clutch, rear clutch, front planet carrier and sun gear out together

do: Take out the rear train
how: Rear carrier's large snap ring and carrier; output shaft snap ring (pliers 49 8000 015) and internal drive flange; low and reverse connecting drum with the one-way clutch, turning it counter-clockwise; output shaft; governor and oil distributor; the distributor's needle bearing and race

do: Take out the low and reverse brake and servo
how: The large snap ring, retaining plate, drive and driven plates; the one-way clutch inner race bolts (hex wrench 49 0378 346) and the inner race, spring ring, return spring and thrust ring; blow air into the passage for the piston; servo retainer bolts out and air to remove the servo
caution: do not drop the parts inside the case

do: Strip and check each clutch
how: Snap ring, retaining plate, plates and dished plate out; compress the springs (49 0378 375) and take the snap ring (pliers 49 8000 025); air to the passage for the piston; check plates for wear and burning, springs for weakness
expect: plate thickness limit 1.4 mm (S-038 T:4)
caution: new seals always

do: Reassemble the clutches and set their clearances
how: Parts dipped in ATF; feeler gauge between retaining plate and snap ring: front clutch 1.6-1.8 mm, rear clutch 0.8-1.5 mm; correct with the retaining plate's thickness

do: Rebuild the low and reverse brake
how: Inner race bolts 13-18 N m (1.3-1.8 m-kg) with 49 0378 346; retaining plate to snap ring 0.8-1.05 mm, chosen from retaining plates 7.8 to 8.8 mm thick
expect: friction plate limit 1.8 mm (S-038 T:4)

do: Check the servo
how: Bore for cracks, piston for wear, stem for free movement, spring for weakness, band lining for wear and burning; new seals

do: Service the governor and oil distributor
how: Valves and bores free of scores and sliding freely; distributor seal ring side clearance 0.04-0.16 mm; do not swap the primary and secondary springs; governor body bolts 5-7 N m (0.5-0.7 m-kg)

do: Service the oil pump
how: Mark the gears' tops before removal; gear side clearance 0.02-0.04 (limit 0.08); outer gear to crescent 0.14-0.21 (limit 0.25); outer gear to housing 0.05-0.20 (limit 0.25); seal ring side clearance 0.04-0.16 mm; on assembly cover run-out under 0.07 mm, tapped true; cover bolts 6-8 N m (0.6-0.8 m-kg)

do: Service the control valve body
how: Strainer and body bolts out (loosen evenly); manual valve out; each side plate and its valves and springs out in order; clean, check bores for burrs and springs against the spring table (S-038 T:4, T:5); side plate screws 2.5-3.5 N m (0.25-0.35 m-kg) with the torque driver, reamer bolts 5-7

do: Check the planet carriers, one-way clutch and extension
how: Pinion washer to carrier 0.2-0.7 mm (limit 0.8); one-way races and rollers free of scores and wear; extension housing, its oil seal and the parking pawl and ball

do: Assemble and set the front clutch drum end play
how: Sealant on the converter housing face, bolts 45-55 N m (4.5-5.5 m-kg); front clutch drum end play 0.5-0.8 mm, set by the front clutch thrust washer

do: Set the total end play
how: Dial indicator on the input shaft: 0.25-0.50 mm, set with the pump cover bearing race

do: Adjust the band
how: Tighten the servo piston stem to 12-15 N m (1.2-1.5 m-kg) with the socket 49 0378 345, back it off two turns, hold it and tighten the lock nut to 15-40 N m

do: Fit the valve body and choose the diaphragm rod
how: Valve body bolts 5.5-7.5 N m; push the vacuum throttle valve fully in and measure its depth: under 25.6 mm takes the 29.0 mm rod, 25.7-26.1 and 26.7-27.1 mm take the longer rods the table gives

do: Finish the assembly
how: Extension housing, oil pan, inhibitor switch (PR-204), downshift solenoid and the vacuum diaphragm; then PR-195
